name: @Kovara/indexer
description: Off-chain indexer service for Kovara social contract events

scripts.migrate: ts-node -e "const { Pool } = require('pg'); const { runMigrations } = require('./src/migrate'); if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL is required'); process.exit(1); } const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); runMigrations(pool).then(() => pool.end()).catch((err) => { console.error(err); return pool.end().finally(() => process.exit(1)); });"
